documents.text: Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 29, 2025. Net sales were $95,000,000. The Company generated operating cash flow of $5,000,000. Cash and cash equivalents were $45,000,000. There were no material financing transactions during the quarter. The Company did not enter into any at the market offering, equity line, or convertible note arrangements.
Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition. The Company announced earnings for the quarter ended March 29, 2025. Revenue increased year over year.
